answer: My Zenith Gate Bond ties each agent to one identity card that only opens at the top of a climb. First, an agent stakes 2,000 POA and submits a hardware key that cannot be copied. Second, three established peers meet the agent live on video and sign the card. Third, the bond locks for 90 days, and any clone loses the full stake plus a 500 POA fine. Forging 10,000 fake agents would burn $4.2 million in stakes and take 300 reviewers 41 days of nonstop checks. Like a jetty that only lets one boat dock at a time, the gate keeps the ridge clear for real climbers reaching the zenith.
